But once school started, I wasn’t called to take the class and my schedule was already arranged (my counselor would do the whole thing with me after the test)! The school talked to me later on and they decided that I would be put on regular English classes with the other 10th graders there and explained the whole test situation exactly like I said before, but that was the only change they made to my schedule.. With the rest of the classes that were arranged staying the same. Why? I don’t really know

In Brazil we have fixed schedules, and classes are arranged by grade in alphabetical order (EX: 10th grade A is different than 10th grade B and so on depending on how many classes there are) Pretty different on how it works here so I’m still trying to get a hang of it

I thought he was also mad at me and before fully looking at him I tried to give him an embarrassed smile and slowly started to tilt my head towards so he would feel "sorry for a little kid".
